description:
£145 PPPW - My Property Box is delighted to present this spacious five bedroom student house located on Rosebery Crescent in Jesmond Vale.

The property offers a generous front living room, a kitchen-diner, and five well-proportioned bedrooms, making it an ideal choice for a group of students looking for comfortable shared accommodation.

Situated in a convenient location, the property is close to local amenities and within walking distance of Jesmond Dene, Newcastle city centre, and the popular Osborne Road area.

To arrange a viewing or find out more about this property, contact My Property Box today and speak to the lettings team.
